headline.caveat: Valor anchors the SPV's ~$7.5B total equity tranche; Valor's own commitment is undisclosed

nature_md: Valor Equity Partners — Antonio Gracias's firm and a long-standing Musk-company investor — is the anchor of the ~$7.5B equity tranche of the ~$20B SPV that buys NVIDIA GPUs and leases them to xAI for Colossus 2 (Memphis). Other equity participants include NVIDIA (up to $2B); ~$12.5B of debt was arranged by Apollo, Diameter Capital Partners, and others. Final close of the full $20B was reported in progress in Oct 2025 and has not been separately confirmed.

accounting.payer_treatment_md: LP capital deployed from Valor-managed funds as SPV equity; returns depend on xAI lease performance and GPU residual value after the 5-year lease.
accounting.payee_treatment_md: First-loss equity beneath the SPV's GPU-collateralized debt stack.
